author: Carolina
title: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator! I’m looking for a creative talent who can: Create flat character illustrations (2D). Design and develop 3D characters. Animate characters in both 2D and 3D. Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus. If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com

author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author looking for character artists for dark fantasy book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

author: Hayley Quinn
title: Looking for semi-realistic artist for two fantasy characters, budget $300
content: NO DMS. Strict budget up to $300 & looking for someone to accept half payment before starting. Looking for an artist in a semi realistic/realistic art style to draw two characters in a fantasy setting from Danielle L. Jensen’s new duology Defy The Dusk. The focus will be on the two characters in a dancing scene, and background will be minimal. This will be for personal use & there is no deadline. Please share your portfolio so I can get a sense of your style. Thank you!
